row_grain: one row per UFC bout (post-2000-11-17, non-excluded)

columns.winner: derived; null for draws and NCs
columns.loser: derived; null for draws and NCs
columns.is_excluded: true for NC / Overturned / Could Not Continue (these rows live in _excluded_bouts.csv only)
columns.method_class: bucketed: KO/TKO | Submission | Decision - Unanimous/Majority/Split | DQ | Could Not Continue | Overturned | Other
columns.method_score_winner: winner score for μ_method rating; null for μ_canonical inputs
columns.details_text: Greco DETAILS verbatim (judge scorecards live here)
columns.ped_confirmed: derived from details_text; true when Greco confirms a failed drug test or anti-doping violation tied to the bout
columns.ped_flagged_fighter: fighter named by the PED confirmation text, when inferable
columns.ped_confirmation_source: source field used for the PED flag
columns.ped_confirmation_detail: verbatim details_text used for PED audit
